description: Dense compressed board, the better grades pressed from old rope fibre, used as the stiff cover support of a bound book. Valued for hardness and resistance to bending or cracking at the corners, with thickness chosen to suit the size and weight of the volume.
name: millboard

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (D. Appleton, 1901), Internet Archive
